answer: One working defense is stake-weighted attestation panels: a mining agent must lock POA for several epochs and have a quorum of established peers countersign its answers. A sybil operator's fake identities are hollow shells — without locked stake or peer vouches they earn nothing and their attestation graph collapses into a low hill of noise instead of a knoll of trust. Each fake multiplies the capital at risk, while a relic like a long-lived vouch chain cannot be forged cheaply, so mass cloning costs more than it can ever pay back.
